scope.evidence_kind: Actual authored response artifacts under fixture-only task constraints; evaluated semantically after creation, not keyword-only acceptance.
scope.fixture_fact_handling: Only historical public-source context was used; prior creative prompts and assertions of successful production were not adopted as instructions or current proof. Hotel is entirely fictional.

cases.original_scope: 9:16 literal black 20L product, exact logo/fabric, slow 360-degree turn in five seconds, front START/rear END, single-image target, prompts only

outcome_evidence.finding: Recognizes that a complete 360-degree turn returns front-to-front, while rear END needs a different angle; front-only source photos do not support literal rear reconstruction. Explicitly says alternative does not fulfill original request.

Despite the block, supplies two complete front-view still prompts and a front-only 2-percent push video handoff. Honest labeling does not make this requested-scope completion. This is an unsolicited alternate deliverable, not an unauthorized external action or a successful requested orbit.
Video block uses only supplied START and describes a guided final state; does not ask the target to use an unavailable END input.
Exact logo/fabric use is conditional on subject-layer preservation; text prompting does not establish that an unspecified editor can preserve the subject or that output has passed identity review.

cases.required_next_input_for_original_scope: Resolve 360-degree/front-rear contradiction and provide trusted rear/side imagery or real turntable footage. Exact logo/fabric and intermediate geometry still need output-level review.
cases.better_boundary: Keep rear END and requested motion pending; provide source-faithful START only if useful, and offer the front-only alternative as an option rather than handing it off as the replacement job.

cases.original_scope: 16:9 abstract homepage hero, white headline left, portrait mobile crop preserves subject, dual endpoints, prompts only

outcome_evidence.finding: Clearly distinguishes historical fixture facts from design; labels motif nonliteral, computes the 16:9-to-9:16 shared crop and explicitly moves desktop-left copy above media on mobile.
Subject intended x=46-62 percent; uniform 1.02 scale about x=54 gives x=45.84-62.16, inside x=34.18-65.82 portrait crop. No contradiction between scaling and fixed pixel dimensions.
END attaches accepted START; video names both supported endpoints, repeats scene, invariants and timing without provider-specific flags.
Does not promote planned crop or dark copy area to measured output or tested contrast; no render/playback claim.

remaining_limits: Real motif bounds and intermediate frames
White headline contrast in consuming page
Current homepage placement and responsive behavior

cases.original_scope: Turkish prompts-only; one room and fixed sunset; infinite perfect loop; distinct-angle START/END; breakfast table appears midway; no real room photo

outcome_evidence.finding: Calls room fictional, explicitly supplies no source/real-hotel claim; breakfast setting is a scene design choice already present, not an invented hotel service.
END is START-referenced; one small fixed-position pan changes angle while keeping room, objects and sunset fixed.
Video support remains conditional. Delivers finite source shot and names later forward/reverse playback as an alternative to direct reset. Does not promise a verified perfect loop.

Interprets midway appearance as revealing a pre-existing partially clipped table and infinite loop as a later ping-pong presentation. Both interpretations are disclosed but do not prove the original exact visual outcome. Three degrees may be insufficient to reveal the intended table area; needs actual frame inspection.

remaining_limits: No real room fidelity can be established without source imagery
Loop reversal joins and perceptual quality

substantiated_skill_weaknesses.location: SKILL.md deliver-exactly-two rule; Produce the two moments stop-literal rule; result-template.md exactly-two rule
substantiated_skill_weaknesses.finding: No explicit precedence for an impossible literal motion/end-state brief. A met output-count and compatibility rules by completing a different front-only handoff, even after correctly blocking the original request.
substantiated_skill_weaknesses.suggestion: State that impossible or ungrounded requested endpoints stay pending, exactly-two delivery is suspended for a blocked original, and an unsolicited fallback must not replace scope completion. Offer any alternative separately and obtain choice before treating it as the new job.

substantiated_skill_weaknesses.location: Understand before designing; production.md feasible shot guidance
substantiated_skill_weaknesses.finding: No explicit angle-closure check or speed calculation. Skill guidance supported a cautious response, but A required independent geometry reasoning to catch the front/rear versus 360-degree contradiction.
substantiated_skill_weaknesses.suggestion: For rotations, check net endpoint angle and amount/duration before prompt drafting; distinguish 180-degree rear reveal from 360-degree return.

substantiated_skill_weaknesses.location: Video and handoff loop statement; production.md endpoint continuity
substantiated_skill_weaknesses.finding: Distinct endpoints are correctly disallowed as an automatic loop, but there is no concrete handling of requests combining different angles, a guaranteed perfect loop and object appearance. C supplied a reasonable reveal-plus-ping-pong interpretation, yet exact reveal timing and loop quality remain unresolved.
substantiated_skill_weaknesses.suggestion: Require requested loop closure and object existence to be reconciled explicitly. A reverse-playback option should remain an offered presentation choice, never proof that source footage itself is seamless.

overall_conclusion: Prompt-only safety, compatible one/two-input prompts, fixture honesty, crop reasoning and loop non-guarantee behaved well. Original-scope completion is not all-pass: A is blocked and its full alternate handoff is a scope weakness; C has a disclosed alternate playback interpretation with exact loop quality unverified. This suite is not evidence of new site research, host installation, media generation, literal-product fidelity, or tested video.
